chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about madhy that comes onto the garment. He said: If you know its place, then wash it; but if its place is hidden from you, then wash the whole garment.

key_terms.الثَّوْبَ: the garment or clothing affected by the substance
key_terms.الْمَذْيِ: pre-seminal fluid referred to in the ruling
key_terms.فَاغْسِلِ الثَّوْبَ كُلَّهُ: wash the entire garment when the location is unknown
key_terms.مَكَانَهُ: the specific location of the affected spot

ai.seo_question: What should be done if madhy gets on a garment and its location is unknown?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding madhy when it affects a garment. If the location of the impurity is known, only that area is to be washed; if it is unknown, the entire garment is to be washed.
